name: capa
description: Identify capabilities in executable files using an extensible rule-based matching system

capa.description: Mandiant capability detection tool - identify what malware can do based on static analysis
capa.usage:
capa malware.exe
capa -v malware.exe
capa -j malware.exe
capa -r custom_rules/ malware.exe
capa --format json malware.exe
